content:
**Visual observations:**
- Corn leaves showing prominent white to pale green parallel streaking running the length of the leaves
- Streaks vary in width and alternate with green tissue
- Some leaves appear narrow and erect
- A few leaves show shredded/tattered texture
- Plants appear somewhat stunted compared to neighbors; tassels visible on surrounding plants

**Key differentiators:**
- The broad white parallel stripes alternating with green tissue are the hallmark of **Downy mildew**
- Not a mosaic/mottle pattern (rules out MDMV/MCDV)
- No discrete spots or pustules (rules out rust, eyespot, leaf blights)
- No tassel deformation (rules out Crazy top, Head smut)
- The shredded leaf appearance matches the description: "white parallel stripes eventually turn brown and disintegrate, resulting in a shredded appearance"
